definitions: A type of yarn specifically designed to form the pile (the raised surface) of fabrics such as carpets, velvets, and terry cloth.
Yarn used to create loops or cut ends that stand up from the base fabric, giving it a soft or textured feel.
examples: The carpet factory ordered a large shipment of pile yarn.
Different types of pile yarn can create varied textures.
The quality of the pile yarn affects the durability of the rug.
